phrases.latin: Avus et avia, quī in cubiculō proximō dormīverant, sarcinīs collēctīs parātī in vestibulō exspectābant. Ratiōne putātā ā dēversōriō discessum est.
phrases.english: Grandpa and Grandma, who had slept in the next room, had packed and were waiting ready in the lobby. The bill was settled and they checked out.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum
Cic. Verr. 2.4.40; Liv. 21.47.2 (Lewis & Short s.v. vās)

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 217, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.
